subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR's redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests be accepted as sufficient proof for the xAI stale encrypted_content recovery, despite the lack of an after-fix real Grok rotation capture?
rationale: The contributor plausibly explains that the exact code-less xAI error requires provider-side stale ciphertext and cannot be induced on demand, while ClawSweeper's default external-PR proof gate requires after-fix real behavior proof or an explicit maintainer override.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the production logs, source-level repro, tests, and green checks as enough for this provider-owned failure mode and allow maintainer merge review to proceed.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future real xAI rotation produces redacted after-fix retry evidence.

options.title: Replace with maintainer-run proof
options.body: Have a maintainer with xAI access attempt the closest safe live gateway validation and then decide whether to override the exact rotation proof gap.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the production logs, source-level repro, tests, and green checks as enough for this provider-owned failure mode and allow maintainer merge review to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the sibling merged encrypted-content retry recovery and is the clearest code-history owner for deciding proof sufficiency on the same predicate.
